# Therapist Aid

> Free and premium therapy worksheets, interactive tools, guided audio, and educational resources for mental health professionals and their clients.

Therapist Aid provides a comprehensive library of evidence-based therapeutic materials including CBT and DBT worksheets, interactive digital tools, guided meditations, therapy videos, and clinical articles. The platform serves both therapists and clients with customizable resources for individual and group therapy sessions.

## Key Topics

- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- Therapy Worksheets
- Interactive Tools
- Guided Audio & Meditation
- Anxiety Management
- Depression Support
- Anger Management
- Emotion Literacy
- Client Education
- Therapy Videos
- Relationships & Communication
- Grief Counseling
- Mental Health Resources
- Professional Guides

## Core Therapy Resources

- [Therapy Worksheets](https://www.therapistaid.com/therapy-worksheets): Library of free therapy worksheets covering CBT, DBT, anger management, and stress.
- [Interactive Therapy Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/interactive-therapy-tools): Digital tools combining audio, storybooks, and activities for client engagement.
- [Therapy Videos](https://www.therapistaid.com/therapy-videos): Free therapy videos covering CBT, anger management, relaxation, and stress management.
- [Therapy Audio Resources](https://www.therapistaid.com/audio-resources): Guided audio exercises including meditations, relaxation, and visualization techniques.
- [Digital Therapy Tools & Activities](https://www.therapistaid.com/activities): Interactive therapy tools including assessments, games, and activities for in-person/remote use.

## Clinical Topic Tools

- [Anxiety Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/anxiety): Anxiety resources including CBT/DBT worksheets and interactive tools for clients.
- [Depression Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/depression): Depression management worksheets, guides, and CBT/DBT tools for therapists.
- [Anger Management Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/anger): Anger management worksheets, guides, and interactive tools for therapy practice.
- [Emotion Literacy & Exploration Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/emotions): Emotion exploration worksheets and interactive tools for emotion literacy development.
- [Relationships Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/relationships): Relationship counseling worksheets and interactive tools for therapy practice.
- [Communication Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/communication): Communication worksheets and interactive activities for therapy practice.
- [Grief Tools](https://www.therapistaid.com/tools/grief): Grief support worksheets and interactive tools for grief counseling practice.

## Professional Content & Guides

- [Therapy Articles](https://www.therapistaid.com/therapy-articles): Article directory with professional guides on CBT, anger management, and mental health topics.
- [Therapy Guides for Professionals](https://www.therapistaid.com/therapy-guides): Treatment guides and professional articles for therapists on various clinical topics.

## Educational & Storytelling Resources

- [Stories for Therapy](https://www.therapistaid.com/stories): Digital storybooks for clinicians teaching kids about emotions, anxiety, and relationships.

## Membership & Account

- [Therapist Aid Home](https://www.therapistaid.com): Therapist Aid homepage offering free worksheets, guides, and videos for mental health professionals.
- [Membership Plans](https://www.therapistaid.com/plans): Membership plans and pricing tiers for Therapist Aid premium content and features.
